name: real-catalogue-eval
description: Relevance judgements over 4000 real Open Library records. Pooled top-20 from each retrieval lane, judged by claude-haiku-4-5 blind to which lane retrieved each record. relevant_doc_ids uses grade >= 2 (clearly relevant); per-document grades are kept in `grades`.
caveat: POOLING BIAS: records retrieved by neither lane were never judged, so recall is relative to the pool rather than absolute. The judge is an LLM validated by sampling, not human ground truth. Queries were drafted by the system's author and edited by the reviewer.
